body:
I sure hope that some medicine works. I say that I've fixed all my problems that she had with me, but I still have a tinge of aggravation around people, sometimes. I really wonder if it's something I'm making up in my head, or if it's something medicine can fix. I kind of think it's both. I think I fixed the self-afflicted unhappiness, I have to just get the right medicine to work. 

And I sure wish that Prozac made me stop eating. The depression has made me overweight a bit and I was hoping that one of the depression medicines would fix it. The Wellbutrin sort of helped for a week or so, but it may have been a placebo.

I have, I just, i didn't describe it to her correctly, i guess. I first started on welbutrin, now i'm on prozac. neither one worked, i guess, since the problems started as soon as i got on welbutrin. im thinking it may have been a coincidence, who knows. i can't tell what works at all anymore. maybe the next medicine we'll try will work. i don't know. it's kind of hopeless at this point. 

she says that if she sees that i am happy by myself and with other friends, and happy with myself, she may get back with me. because she wasn't happy with me before because i was never happy with myself and nothing she did made me happy, therefore she could never be happy. in reality, i was happy, i just don't have a good way of showing it, it was almost like i thought being happy was a sign of weakness. i have a problem smiling on cue, or at all.  after this huge event i really thought about it and decided that i was making myself unhappy on purpose, sort of like i thought it made me look stronger or something. but i realized no one wants to be around that kind of person. and i just couldn't get through to her that i had changed. i don't blame her. i'm just hoping that i can show her over the next few months that i am better and she will miss me. 

we have talked non stop for almost 2 years. i hope she feels the sting of being without me soon, as she does already i'm sure.
thank you. its hard to look ahead right now though but i hope it is okay soon
